summary: The late PTY publication regression preserves loader environment variables on macOS

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: The test helper runs its already-required Python interpreter directly instead of through the macOS system shell, which strips DYLD variables needed by name-only PTY environment forwarding. The native regression explicitly forwards DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH. Product launch behavior is unchanged.
